_about: Name and one-line summary of the product, copied into the extension manifest, userscript header and docs by the build. The long store description is in product-description.txt, where {{homepage}} is replaced with the homepage URL. The build fails if a text exceeds its limit: name 50 (addons.mozilla.org), summary 132 (Chrome's limit for the manifest description; AMO allows 250), description 5000 (this project's own readability guideline).
name: Text Size Adjuster
summary: Make a page's text bigger or smaller with one tap — without zooming the whole page or scrolling sideways.
